target_profile.notes: Do not install platform-specific Ollama/Piper binaries until the actual VPS OS/architecture and available disk/RAM are verified.

ollama.policy: One main model on ordinary chat. Embedding model only on RAG paths. Keep base reference and uncensored candidate unloaded sequentially on 8-GB hardware.

whisper_cpp.build: CMake release build from the pinned source commit

qwen_asr.backend: Transformers for CPU-first evaluation; vLLM optional only with suitable GPU

qwen_reranker.runtime_candidate: Transformers 4.57.6 + CPU PyTorch in an isolated worker environment
qwen_reranker.activation: Only after first-stage FTS5/vector retrieval and only if measured nDCG/MRR improves.

tesseract.note: 5.5.4 release fixes 17 security advisories. Install from the target OS package source or build this exact source; verify tesseract --version before use.

silero_vad.runtime: ONNX Runtime CPU; pin exact onnxruntime wheel after target architecture confirmation

proposed_not_implemented.embeddings: Internal adapter to Ollama POST /api/embed; invoke only during RAG ingest/query.
proposed_not_implemented.rerank: Internal worker around Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B; not a public API until permissions and timeouts are defined.
proposed_not_implemented.ocr: Internal Tesseract worker; extend /v1/documents/extract only after scanned-PDF tests.
proposed_not_implemented.qwen_asr: Optional local worker adapter; retain Whisper as baseline until WER/RTF eval passes.

current: SQLite (FTS5 lexical retrieval, response cache, AgentRunStore prototype)
storage.decision: Do not add PostgreSQL, Redis or Qdrant until dataset scale, concurrency and latency benchmarks show SQLite/FTS5 plus measured vector storage is insufficient.

request_path_policy.ordinary_chat: Browser -> FastAPI gateway -> Ollama main model, one model call by default.
request_path_policy.rag: Only when user enables/requests RAG: FTS5 candidate retrieval -> Ollama /api/embed; optional reranker after first-stage retrieval if eval passes.
request_path_policy.voice: Only when voice mode is used: VAD -> ASR; TTS only when speech output is requested.
request_path_policy.documents: Only when a document is uploaded: native parser first, OCR only for pages without usable text.
request_path_policy.agents: No full agent runtime is claimed by this lock; AgentRunStore is storage prototype. Tool execution remains behind approval/permission gates.
